name: 23_move_toothbrush
title: Tidying Objects Around Sneaker
summary: A dual-arm robot places a toothbrush in a cup, hides a toy train inside a sneaker, rearranges tabletop items, and retrieves the train.
robot: two black robotic arms with two-finger parallel grippers
setting: a grey patterned table with assorted toys and household items

segments.instruction: Move the green toothbrush across the table toward the purple cup while the camera stays fixed.
Place the toothbrush upright into the purple cup and release the gripper.
Reach with the right gripper toward the small toy train on the lower right and grasp it.
Slide the toy train deep into the opening of the sneaker until it is completely out of view.
segments.memory_event: hide: toy train is inserted into the sneaker opening and fully obscured

segments.instruction: Move the left gripper to the red toy bus in the background and push it forward.
Pick up the small paper wrapper on the right and shift it slightly backward.
Reach into the sneaker with the right gripper to grasp what was placed inside.
segments.memory_event: return: the toy train is retrieved from inside the sneaker, identical to before

segments.instruction: Pull the object out of the sneaker and set it down on the table beside the red bus.
